title: Highly Recommend!

title: Wonderful day
text:
Magnificent and perfectly organized experience. We traveled with Petra (a force of nature, adorable!) through the Albaicin neighborhood and visited the Alhambra with Eduardo, in just under three hours she showed us the main points of the city and told us so many things.
The organization of the day was perfect and I thank the agency for helping us find a place even though the tour was fully booked!
author: clau952019

title: Great day!
text: Beautiful place. A must must see. Tour was very organized. Covered a lot without feeling rushed. Great guides and driver, comfortable bus. All around excellent experience.
author: G4793XVsusanm

title: Very good experience
text: Our guide did an amazing job his knowledge was very well presented to us and we where very relaxed during the tour. His pace was well suited for the four of us at no time did we feel rushed. I would recommend spending the extra money for a private tour.
author: steven_l

title: Great tour
text:
Great tour, the guide on the bus (Alex) was great and very friendly. The guide in Alhambra was also great! 
The day before I got a WhatsApp message with the starting hour and pick up location. There was a little bit   of a delay because of the traffic in Seville, but from there on everything went smoothly.
author: C1405FLjustinev

title: Incredible!
text: We had the most incredible guide named Fernando. His English was perfect and he was super knowledgeable. His excitement to share the beauty of the Alhambra made the experience so enjoyable. Our driver, Miguel, was a courteous and safe driver who made us so comfortable.  Highly recommended!
author: Diane_A

title: Worth for the money good service
text: Good service. Luca the tour guide provided great service. Only issue was that the bus seating was not organized properly ler family. We were able to sit together. Bus was comfortable though.
